contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin fragment. Penny, possibly of Ecgbehrt of Wessex (802-825) and of Wessex and other parts of south-east England (825-839). More than two thirds of flan lost. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: (--)CGB(--). Reverse description: unbarred letter A. Initial cross pattee. Reverse inscription: +L(---)[?]L.
